The series is trend‑dominated and ranking unstable; a robust non‑weighted median over the low‑error pool4 may outperform mean and weighted combos.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 1.0. Series context: trend strength 0.9098 and seasonal strength 0.412; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.088); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.317.
